3:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This scenario has no $$Ｄトレーダー$$, but scenario demo 10 is included just in case.」

4:t_000:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's time. All units, take your positions and brace for impact.」

4:t_000:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Repairing space-time will destroy the $$時の牢獄$$... So this is the final moment.」

4:t_000:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「With the threat of $$ジェミニス$$ gone, the world will enter a new era.」

4:t_000:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But we can't let our guard down.」

4:t_000:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Someday, $$バアル$$ will come to Earth... We have to be ready for them.」

4:t_000:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「And there's that guy 《$$尸空#keyword$$》 we saw earlier, too.」

4:t_000:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Earth isn't all we're protecting. We're protecting the entire universe.」

4:t_000:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah... That's the promise we made.」

4:t_000:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「First, let's see our victory through.」

4:t_000:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If we can, I'd like... a little rest afterward.」

4:t_000:11.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah. We're all worn out, and so are our machines.」

4:t_000:12.en:
$$葵$$
「Even we could use a little break.」

4:t_000:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A brief respite... That sounds rather nice.」

4:t_000:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The countdown has begun... The $$時の牢獄$$ will collapse any moment.」

4:t_000:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You did well, $n. Thank you for everything you've done.」

4:t_001:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「I don't get it, but is that really another Earth!?」

4:t_002:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! Something's coming from what used to be the boundary of the $$時の牢獄$$!」

4:t_003:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The organization that includes $$ジェミニス$$, which that man 《$$尸空#keyword$$》 mentioned...」

4:t_003:4.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「They're attacking from beyond the $$時の牢獄$$!?」

4:t_003:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「There are machines I've never seen before, too...!」

4:t_003:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Watch out! They look more powerful than the machines $$ジェミニス$$ used!」

4:t_004:2.en:
$n
「We have... no choice but to fight!」

4:t_004:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! Many suspected $$サイデリアル$$ forces have appeared in other areas, too!」

4:t_004:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「They're all heading for Earth!」

4:t_004:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They were waiting for the $$時の牢獄$$ to be destroyed...!」

4:t_004:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Notify all ships! We'll split our forces to deal with them!」

4:t_004:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$プトレマイオス$$, take $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$ゼロ$$ and the others to point 1204!」

4:t_004:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「We have to do this...! Earth has no strength left to fight!」

4:t_004:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$キリコ$$, I'll need your help, too.」

4:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, head to point 3022! $$超銀河ダイグレン$$, to point 2433!」

4:t_005:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ラー・カイラム$$, report to $$連邦軍$$ headquarters! $$アムロ$$, you have command of the escort units!」

4:t_005:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The remaining ships, $$マクロス・クォーター$$, $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, defend this area!」

4:t_005:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I've sent the formation data for each force! All units, I'm counting on you!」

4:t_005:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Of course! We've finally won, and we can't let those creeps ruin our victory!」

4:t_005:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「Let's all survive and meet again!」

4:t_006:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Major $$オズマ$$, take your team to point 1528.」

4:t_006:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Uruz 1, Uruz 2, $$スカル$$ 2, $$ピクシー$$ 1, you're with me!」

4:t_006:3.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「We're counting on you to hold this front, $$アルト$$!」

4:t_012:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ forces are deploying!」

4:t_012:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, take interception formation! We must never let invaders take the Earth we protected!」

4:t_012:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But...! We're in awful shape after all those battles!」

4:t_012:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I know. The first two minutes will be crucial...」

4:t_012:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I have only one thing to tell you all.」

4:t_012:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, come back alive! You must not die here!」

4:t_007:0.en:
$$ボビー$$
「We made it through somehow, but...」

4:t_007:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...That was probably only the enemy's first wave.」

4:t_008:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So that really was only the first wave...!」

4:t_009:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「This force is mostly new models...!」

4:t_009:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「There's another force deploying behind them!」

4:t_009:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it...! At this rate, they'll never stop coming!」
